title: Primary garden area maximum permanent roof cover 35%
text: Primary garden area (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Maximum permanent roof cover(1): 35% of the primary garden area provided. 1 Permanent roof cover excludes minor projections (eaves).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: coding R30-R80 and R80-equivalent codes (PGA applies from R30 in Chapter 3, p10). 35% of the primary garden area provided. Permanent roof cover excludes eaves.
